fees.note: Saugeen Conservation's fee schedule (read 2026-10-13) lists C$50 a night for a non-serviced site and C$60 for a serviced one, and C$50 for either out of season, all including 13% HST (C$44.25 and C$53.10 before it), plus a non-refundable C$16 reservation fee per site.  On Campspot, read the same day for October 14 and 16, 2026, the last nights before the campground closes for the year on October 18, serviced and unserviced sites cost C$46.90 a night before HST and a prime site C$60.18, plus the reservation fee at C$14.16 (C$16 with HST); the horse-camping sites are left out.

source: https://www.saugeenconservation.ca/outdoors-recreation/camping/reserve-a-campsite/ (camping fee schedule, 'Fees (Includes HST)': 'Daily (overnight) serviced site $60.00', 'Daily (overnight) non serviced site $50.00', 'Off season daily camping (serviced or non serviced) $50.00', 'Reservation fee (non refundable) $16.00'), read 2026-10-13; https://www.campspot.com/book/saugeenbluffs (Campspot's pricing for each RV site, one night from 2026-10-14 and 2026-10-16, 2 adults: the Serviced (T) and Unserviced (T) sites C$46.90, the Prime (T) sites C$60.18, a C$14.16 'Reservation Fee' on the (T) sites; the TE, TEC and SE sites, C$51.33-70.80, match the horse-camping fees and are left out; the park record shows it closed from 2026-10-18; campspot_tier_2026-10-13.jsonl), read 2026-10-13

_patch.note: Read on the Campspot marketplace: one night for 2 adults, site rate before tax, every RV site type a 23-ft rig fits (30 Amp Basic W/E (Non-Sewer) Site, 30 Amp Basic Back In RV Site, 30/50 Amp Back Row Back In RV Site, 30/50 Amp Front Row Back In RV Site, 30/50 Amp North End Back In RV Site and 4 more). October 2026: $25-60 on a Tuesday. January 2027 and June 2027: $25-60 on a Tuesday; $30-60 on a Saturday. Saturday, October 17, 2026 falls in the Born Free Texas motorcycle show (October 15 to 19), when Campspot charged $160-280 with a 3-night minimum; the Tuesday after it still asked for 3 nights. Plus the park's '$2 Transaction Fee', once per stay. Read 2026-10-13.
